{{Quote|We've been caught with our pants down and I need someone trustworthy who can clean up the mess quickly and quietly.|Elias Inkari|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Elias Inkari''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Outpost Zerek]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he asked a fellow Republic citizen to retrieve valuable data from the sensors in the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]].
